doc.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 22, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Roy Haynes quote and being nice on the way up
summary: He quotes Roy Haynes about someone out there who can beat you, stresses continued learning and kindness.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: You are an absolute delight, Ignacio, I’m telling you.
So that would be my advice to students, and then now whomever is going to see this interview, I’m going to quote my mentor, my hero, Roy Haynes and I’m going to say just

a tiny bad word. Roy Haynes always said, “Don’t forget that somewhere out there you can meet someone who is going to kick your ass.” And that’s how we tell the students. Yeah man, let’s get a great command of our instrument. Let’s make the foundation solid so we can build that skyscraper that you want to build, and let’s be humble and let’s continue learning because this is a never-ending learning process, and don’t allow this to get to your head, everybody will get our 15 minutes of glory, and then that said —I can say another thing that probably a young musician doesn’t know, be nice to people on your way up, because you are going to meet them on your way down.
